an4.241:1.1: bhikkhave samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo,
an4.241:1.3: evam etaṃ bhikkhave sammā sīhanādaṃ nadatha. 2.
an4.241:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
an4.241:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti.
an4.241:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tatthaparinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an4.241:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ . . . diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.241:6.1: Idh' eva bhikkhave samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo,
an4.241:6.3: evam etaṃ bhikkhave sammā sīhanādaṃ nadatitī. 240.
